policy: kill first; SPAN_UNDERIVED candidates are ineligible (R377 evidence-derivation requirement); R397 Phase 2: DOES_NOT_BEAT_BASELINE and PLAUSIBILITY_BOUND_VIOLATED candidates are ineligible for release (the machine's own physics gates the claim); among survivors prefer better E15-B verdict, then BEATS_BASELINE, then fewer deficient areas, then fewer UNCERTAIN attack outcomes; NO numeric score is computed (CEO standing rule: no new scoring systems)

ranked.mechanism: Thermal and mechanical process parameter control via two-level ANOVA design to mitigate print defect sensitivity
ranked.intervention: Implement a controlled thermal chamber with precise ambient temperature regulation and correlate nozzle temperature with layer adhesion metrics

ranked.mechanism: Thermal instability and rheological changes in the material flow during printing caused by nozzle temperature and print speed interactions.
ranked.intervention: Implement active closed-loop thermal control on the extruder and nozzle to compensate for ambient temperature rises above 35C, specifically by dynamically adjusting nozzle temperature setpoints based on real-time ambient readings to maintain consistent viscosity.

ranked.mechanism: Two-level ANOVA experimental design used to isolate impacts of print speed, nozzle temperature, and layer height on print quality
ranked.intervention: Apply a two-level ANOVA design to the 3D printer to statistically isolate the effect of ambient temperature on layer adhesion versus extruder temperature; specifically, measure the extruder and bed temperature stability while varying ambient conditions.

ranked.mechanism: Statistical optimization of print speed, nozzle temperature, and layer height via two-level ANOVA to control deposition fidelity.
ranked.intervention: Apply a two-level ANOVA experimental design varying print speed, nozzle temperature, and layer height to identify the parameter combination that prevents polycarbonate layer skipping at ambient temperatures above 35C.

ranked.mechanism: In-situ filament thermal stability monitoring via infrared radiometry to detect premature thermal degradation and plasticizer loss in polycarbonate
ranked.intervention: Integrate non-contact IR temperature sensing on the filament spool and hot-end extruder to track the thermal degradation signature of polycarbonate under high ambient conditions

selection_basis.mechanism: Statistical optimization of print speed, nozzle temperature, and layer height via two-level ANOVA to control deposition fidelity.
selection_basis.intervention: Apply a two-level ANOVA experimental design varying print speed, nozzle temperature, and layer height to identify the parameter combination that prevents polycarbonate layer skipping at ambient temperatures above 35C.
